entries.title: Access
entries.summary: Schema for an attempt or outcome around reaching, opening, visiting, reading, observing, contacting, or otherwise gaining access to a bounded target.

entries.title: Adapter Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation produced from adapter-observed or adapter-imported material.

entries.title: Adapter
entries.summary: This schema defines adapter-definition artifacts as a specialized interface family.

entries.title: AI Runtime
entries.summary: This schema narrows the machine-runtime layer to artifacts whose main signal is AI-runtime behavior such as request framing, model or assistant output, tool-mediated execution, and outcome interpretation.

entries.title: Annotation
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable annotation artifact.

entries.title: Artifact Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an annotation attached to a Tiinex artifact, artifact region, material fragment, file entry, node, section, span, image region, canvas region, or comparable bounded part of an artifact.

entries.title: Artifact Transition
entries.summary: Defines a legacy transition artifact for an artifact, artifact region, span, selection, material fragment, schema-guided node, or related artifact-bound target.

entries.title: Attestation
entries.summary: This schema defines attestation artifacts whose main job is to preserve a scoped statement made by a person, role, organization, witness, lab, authority, or other attesting party.

entries.title: Availability
entries.summary: Schema for when or under what conditions a party, resource, room, tool, facility, source, channel, system, or bounded target is available, unavailable, limited, reserved, busy, tentative, or unknown.

entries.title: Claim
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable claim artifact.

entries.title: Condition
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable condition artifact.

entries.title: Decision
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to record a landed decision in a way that later readers, traces, and tools can treat as operative.

entries.title: Derivation
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable derivation artifact.

entries.title: Digital Adapter
entries.summary: This schema defines digital adapter artifacts.

entries.title: Digital Origin
entries.summary: This schema defines digital origin artifacts.

entries.title: Discovery Breakthrough
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable discovery breakthrough artifact.

entries.title: Discovery Expedition
entries.summary: This schema narrows discovery into expedition: exploratory movement through a partly unknown field where the goal is to map terrain, notice encounters, preserve routes, and return with clearer orientation.

entries.title: Discovery Finding
entries.summary: This schema narrows discovery into a finding: one thing noticed, encountered, missing, unexpected, ambiguous, or worth triage during a discovery.

entries.title: Discovery Follow
entries.summary: This schema narrows discovery into follow: a lightweight, bounded, and usually low-friction form of ongoing attention.

entries.title: Discovery Monitoring
entries.summary: This schema narrows discovery into monitoring: recurring or continued observation of a field, system, process, source, community, environment, dataset, or target over time.

entries.title: Discovery Research
entries.summary: This schema narrows discovery into research: a question-driven or hypothesis-driven inquiry that seeks understanding, support, contradiction, context, or decision input through bounded source review.

entries.title: Discovery Surveillance
entries.summary: This schema narrows monitoring into surveillance: high-impact observation that may involve authority, power asymmetry, sensitive subjects, person or group effects, rights or access consequences, automated scoring, coercive contexts, or other conditions that require stronger accountability.

entries.title: Discovery
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to preserve an intentional act of discovery: a bounded search, exploration, inquiry, follow, survey, monitoring pass, expedition, or other attempt to notice what is present, absent, changing, unknown, or worth following.

entries.title: Session Entry
entries.summary: This schema specializes `tiinex.entry.v1` for reusable ways of entering a bounded session.

entries.title: Entry
entries.summary: This schema defines reusable Entry artifacts.

entries.title: Event Deadline
entries.summary: Schema for a time boundary by which something should, must, may, or is expected to happen without making the deadline itself a task or proof of delivery.

entries.title: Event Incident
entries.summary: Schema for an unexpected, disruptive, risky, notable, harmful, or otherwise significant occurrence or reported occurrence without making the incident record proof of cause or blame.

entries.title: Event Meeting
entries.summary: Schema for an event where multiple parties, resources, roles, rooms, channels, or other targets gather or are expected to gather in a shared time or context window.

entries.title: Event Session
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded activity pass such as a workshop, field pass, review pass, stream, build session, research pass, onboarding pass, or work period.

entries.title: Event
entries.summary: Schema for something that is planned to occur, may occur, is occurring, occurred, did not occur, was cancelled, was deferred, was missed, or is uncertain within a bounded time, place, context, or participant boundary.

entries.title: Event Window
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded period or condition window where something is open, possible, valid, observable, available, or allowed without treating the window as permission or availability proof by itself.

entries.title: Evidence
entries.summary: This schema defines evidence artifacts as a preservation specialization.

entries.title: External Payload
entries.summary: This schema defines payload-reference artifacts whose main job is to preserve a readable description of an external, large, binary, private, generated, or machine-shaped payload that should not be fully embedded in markdown.

entries.title: Feedback
entries.summary: This schema narrows signal into directed feedback: a response from a person, system, reviewer, community, runtime, or other source that addresses a target artifact, claim, proposal, work product, or behavior and may require disposition.

entries.title: Handoff Package
entries.summary: Defines one receiver-facing carrier identity/discovery contract with three explicit Package Roles: an exact Handoff-route carrier, a pointerless Workspace-material carrier, and a bootstrap-only carrier with no project/source material. Complete Workspace carriage may continue to use the package-local clear verified or password-sealed complete-snapshot shortcut. Complete or intentionally bounded material whose representation semantics matter independently uses a qualified `tiinex.workspace.representation.v1` binding; exact selected-route closure material with no independent representation lifecycle may instead use the Handoff-carrier-only package-local bounded cache defined below.

entries.title: Handoff
entries.summary: Defines a declarative handoff between one explicit `From` endpoint and one explicit intended `To` endpoint.

entries.title: Consent Instrument
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.instrument.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve an explicit consent, permission, refusal, withdrawal, restriction, or use-boundary instrument.

entries.title: Financial Instrument
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.instrument.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded financial instrument or finance-shaped support arrangement.

entries.title: Instrument
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to preserve an instrument: a formal or semi-formal arrangement, statement, record, or terms-bearing object that carries permissions, restrictions, obligations, rights, authority, access, value-transfer, or use boundaries.

entries.title: Interaction Unit
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable unit of interaction or interpretation.

entries.title: Interface
entries.summary: This schema defines interface-definition artifacts as a specialized tool family.

entries.title: Interpretation
entries.summary: Schema for an explicit interpretation of an artifact, finding, signal, material, observation, or bounded target as another role without mutating the original.

entries.title: Invitation
entries.summary: Schema for a request, offer, reservation request, or invitation for a party, resource, room, tool, facility, source, channel, or bounded target to participate, be present, be used, contribute, respond, accept, or decline.

entries.title: Lineage Upgrade Deferral
entries.summary: This schema narrows decision into a machine-readable decision to acknowledge a known lineage repair, latest replacement, or upstream upgrade without adopting it for the current lineage range.

entries.title: Machine Runtime
entries.summary: This schema narrows the generic runtime layer to artifacts whose signal is primarily machine-produced state, protocol flow, execution ledger, or result package rather than human-curated explanation.

entries.title: Milestone
entries.summary: Schema for a meaningful marker in a project, process, expedition, development line, or coordinated effort that may be planned, reached, missed, moved, blocked, replaced, or uncertain.

entries.title: Natural Origin
entries.summary: This schema defines natural origin artifacts.

entries.title: Origin
entries.summary: This schema defines origin artifacts.

entries.title: Party Group
entries.summary: Schema for a group, team, community, working group, cohort, or informal collective without treating the reference as membership proof or consent from members.

entries.title: Party Organization
entries.summary: Schema for an organization, company, institution, department, unit, or formal organizational party without treating the reference as legal proof or representation authority.

entries.title: Party Person
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded individual person reference without treating the reference as identity proof, consent, authority, employment, or attendance.

entries.title: Party Role
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded role, capacity, responsibility, or authority-facing position without treating the role as proof that a particular person holds it.

entries.title: Party
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded party or actor reference such as a person, role, organization, group, institution, team, community, or other social/organizational participant.

entries.title: Pointer
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to point a reader toward an upstream trace, origin, or small set of destinations without duplicating the full content of those targets.

entries.title: Portal Time
entries.summary: Defines a portal for viewing a source as of a requested moment or bounded time window.

entries.title: Portal
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable source-resolution boundary.

entries.title: Presentation Surface
entries.summary: Defines a bounded presentation surface where artifact material, interaction units, validation reports, or module capabilities may be shown, asked, filled, selected, inspected, or audited.

entries.title: Preservation
entries.summary: Schema for material that has been captured, copied, archived, photographed, transcribed, exported, taken into custody, or otherwise made available for later judgment.

entries.title: Privacy Boundary
entries.summary: This schema defines privacy-boundary artifacts whose main job is to make sensitivity, sharing, serialization, and disclosure limits explicit for Tiinex artifacts, payloads, claims, people, cases, samples, or related material.

entries.title: Project
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded coordinated effort over time with purpose, scope, parties, resources, tasks, events, milestones, decisions, risks, and outcomes without making one project methodology the base concept.

entries.title: Projection Annotation
entries.summary: Defines a spatial annotation for a bounded transform or projection between reference frames.

entries.title: Quantum Traversal Runtime
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.traversal.runtime.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve quantum-specific or quantum-like traversal of a declared candidate space.

entries.title: Question
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable question artifact.

entries.title: Redaction
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.reduction.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to make a redaction, masking, removal, omission, generalization, or disclosure reduction observable.

entries.title: Reduction
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded carry-forward state produced from fuller source material, while making the reduction itself observable.

entries.title: Relation
entries.summary: This schema defines typed relationship artifacts for Tiinex references that are not direct artifact-continuity parents. Ordinary artifacts and schemas may also declare or project typed relation edges without creating a Relation Artifact.

entries.title: Resource Allocation Usage
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.allocation.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve actual or reported use of an allocated, reserved, or available resource: what was consumed, spent, charged, used, reversed, corrected, or measured during a bounded activity.

entries.title: Resource Allocation
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve allocation: assigning an available, received, or authorized resource to a bounded purpose, plan, task, discovery, expedition, research pass, runtime, or other use.

entries.title: Resource Budget
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded resource budget, quota, cap, reserve, runway, allowance, or operating limit.

entries.title: Resource Contribution Receipt
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.contribution.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve that a contributed resource was received, partially received, returned, reversed, disputed, or is pending confirmation.

entries.title: Resource Contribution
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve a resource contribution: an offer, pledge, donation, transfer, provision, loan, in-kind support, access grant, or other resource made available toward a bounded need or purpose.

entries.title: Resource Need
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.resource.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded resource need: something required, missing, insufficient, expired, unavailable, unauthorized, or otherwise blocking execution.

entries.title: Resource
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to preserve resource-enablement context: what is needed, available, promised, received, allocated, blocked, returned, or no longer available for a plan, task, discovery, expedition, research pass, project, or other bounded work.

entries.title: Root
entries.summary: Defines the minimum shared contract for Tiinex lineage artifacts.

entries.title: Runtime
entries.summary: This schema defines the broad runtime layer for artifacts whose main job is to preserve observed execution state, output, or results rather than hand-authored topic reasoning.

entries.title: Structural Scaffold
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable, machine-projectable contract for reusable material structure such as repository roots, Workspace roots, and bounded directory subtrees.

entries.title: Schedule
entries.summary: Schema for a human-readable timing or ordering structure across events, tasks, milestones, windows, sessions, reviews, resources, or other bounded targets without becoming a calendar app or recurrence engine.

entries.title: Schema Contract
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable schema contract artifact.

entries.title: Schema Example
entries.summary: Defines a contract for a schema example with an expected reading or outcome.

entries.title: Schema Family
entries.summary: This schema defines schema-family artifacts that describe how Tiinex schemas are grouped, extended, created, and interpreted by humans, tools, validators, and future LLM-assisted maintainers.

entries.title: Schema Field
entries.summary: Defines a contract for one named field or input slot in a schema-guided artifact.

entries.title: Schema Generation
entries.summary: Defines a contract for generating a schema-guided artifact or artifact skeleton.

entries.title: Schema Inheritance
entries.summary: Defines a contract for how one schema relates to a parent schema contract.

entries.title: Schema Module
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable bundle of capabilities associated with a Tiinex schema, schema family, or schema chain.

entries.title: Schema Relation
entries.summary: Defines a contract for a relationship between two or more schema contract targets.

entries.title: Schema Rule
entries.summary: Defines a contract for one schema rule.

entries.title: Schema Section
entries.summary: Defines a contract for a section in a schema-guided artifact.

entries.title: Schema Transition Companion
entries.summary: Defines an explicit schema-local attachment set over canonical Transition Definition artifacts.

entries.title: Schema Value
entries.summary: Defines a contract for a value domain used by schema fields and rules.

entries.title: Semantic Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation that attaches semantic labels, tags, classifications, entity mentions, topic labels, controlled vocabulary terms, or meaning hints to an artifact or artifact region.

entries.title: Semantic Package Manifest
entries.summary: Defines a portable boundary for moving and compiling a semantic neighborhood of Tiinex artifacts.

entries.title: Signal
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded signal: an observed reaction, weak indicator, external response, status cue, or other interpretable sign that bears on a lineage without necessarily becoming evidence, feedback, task, or decision.

entries.title: Source
entries.summary: Schema for a chosen, configured, or declared source that a piece of work uses without treating that source as proof, permission, origin truth, or preserved material.

entries.title: Spatial Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation that attaches spatial information to an artifact or artifact region.

entries.title: Style Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation for style, naming, display, authoring convention, lint, readability, or presentation-quality guidance.

entries.title: Task
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to state one bounded unit of work clearly enough to execute, review, or hand off.

entries.title: Temporal Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation that attaches a time value, timecode, interval, duration, frame range, as-of marker, or version-time marker to an artifact or artifact region.

entries.title: Tool
entries.summary: This schema defines tool-definition artifacts.

entries.title: Topic
entries.summary: This schema defines artifacts whose main job is to carry one bounded working topic forward.

entries.title: Transition Definition
entries.summary: Defines a reusable semantic description of a possible bounded transformation.

entries.title: Transition
entries.summary: Defines a human-readable and machine-extractable legacy transition artifact.

entries.title: Transport Envelope
entries.summary: `tiinex.transport.envelope.v1` defines the deterministic, non-secret envelope metadata needed to open one password-sealed Workspace representation payload without treating encryption as Workspace identity, Handoff authority, provenance, semantic truth, or payload-byte integrity authority.

entries.title: Traversal Runtime
entries.summary: This schema narrows `tiinex.runtime.v1` for artifacts whose main job is to preserve a bounded traversal through a candidate space using declared inputs, transition rules, candidate encoding, verifier semantics, executor context, and outcome boundaries.

entries.title: Validation Annotation
entries.summary: Defines an artifact annotation for lightweight validation, lint, check, or status signals attached to an artifact or region.

entries.title: Validation Finding
entries.summary: Schema for one concrete validation observation against a bounded target using a declared method or check boundary.

entries.title: Validation Method
entries.summary: This schema defines validation-method artifacts that describe what a validation method verifies, what it does not verify, and where its trust boundary ends.

entries.title: Validation Report
entries.summary: Schema for a bounded validation pass or review run that collects validation findings, methods, scope, summary, and remaining limits.

entries.title: Workspace Representation
entries.summary: `tiinex.workspace.representation.v1` defines one explicit non-Parent semantic binding between one `tiinex.workspace.v1` artifact and one `tiinex.external.payload.v1` artifact whose payload represents either the complete Workspace byte tree or one explicitly bounded subset of that byte tree.

entries.title: Tiinex Workspace v1 Schema
entries.summary: Defines a markdown-first workspace format for a Tiinex-compatible viewer shell.
